name: The My Bookmarks page on a phone, as admin on Long Test Movie at 390x844 with touch and the mobile layout (localStorage 'layout' = 'mobile'): the My Bookmarks page fits the screen (no horizontal scroll), the row's action buttons collapse into one More button of at least 40 px, which opens our own menu as a full-width bottom sheet with items of at least 40 px (Play from here, Rename, Make a clip, Edit, Delete), the checkbox's label is at least 40 px, the rename's Save and Cancel are too, the Player options dialog and the bulk delete dialog are bottom sheets; then the same page in the Light, Apple TV and Purple Haze themes (a screenshot each, the pressed segment and the bulk bar's Delete… in the theme's accent, Purple Haze's #48c3c8 among them, the text the page's). Seeds and deletes its own 'page-probe phone' bookmarks; the layout and the theme are per browser, and each run has a fresh profile.

steps.name: the page sees a narrow touch screen
find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: the admin's 'page-probe phone' bookmarks of an earlier run deleted
steps.script: const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: 'page-probe phone', limit: 200 })); const ids = r.Items.map(b => b.Id); if (ids.length) await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/BulkDelete'), data: JSON.stringify({ Ids: ids, DeleteClips: true }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return ids.length;

steps.name: seed: a named range with a note and an unnamed point
steps.script: const T = 10000000; const post = (body) => ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); const a = await post({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 30 * T, EndTicks: 34 * T, Name: 'page-probe phone range', Note: 'page-probe phone note, a line under the title' }); const b = await post({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 15 * T, Note: 'page-probe phone point' }); return { a: a.Id, b: b.Id };

steps.name: the seeded ids (webcheck substitutes top-level variables)
the page filtered to the movie
mobile: the page fits in 390 px; each row's action buttons are hidden but More (at least 40 px); the checkbox label is at least 40 px; the toolbar's buttons are at least 40 px tall
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-state="on"]'); if (!r) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || ![__vars.seed.a, __vars.seed.b].every(id => !!c.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + id + '"]'))) return false; const size = (e) => { const b = e.getBoundingClientRect(); return [Math.round(b.width), Math.round(b.height)]; }; const rows = [...c.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row')]; return { kitLayout: __jfkit.jfbm.instance.layout.isMobile(), scrollWidth: document.documentElement.scrollWidth, rowsInside: rows.every(x => x.getBoundingClientRect().left >= 0 && x.getBoundingClientRect().right <= 390), hiddenActions: rows.map(x => [...x.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row-actions button:not(.jfbm-row-more)')].filter(b => b.getClientRects().length > 0).length), more: rows.map(x => size(x.querySelector('.jfbm-row-more'))), selects: rows.map(x => size(x.querySelector('.jfbm-row-select'))), segments: [...r.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-page-segment')].map(size), header: size(r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-options')) }; })()

steps.name: as expected (one column, 40 px touch targets)
steps.assert: __vars.mobile.kitLayout && __vars.mobile.scrollWidth <= 390 && __vars.mobile.rowsInside && __vars.mobile.hiddenActions.every(n => n === 0) && __vars.mobile.more.every(s => s[0] >= 40 && s[1] >= 40) && __vars.mobile.selects.every(s => s[0] >= 40 && s[1] >= 40) && __vars.mobile.segments.every(s => s[1] >= 40) && __vars.mobile.header[1] >= 36

steps.name: scroll the first row into view
the menu: a full-width bottom sheet titled with the bookmark, its items at least 40 px
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop'); const p = b && b.querySelector('.jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'page-probe phone range') return false; const r = p.getBoundingClientRect(); const items = [...p.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row-menu-item')].map(i => { const q = i.getBoundingClientRect(); return [i.textContent, Math.round(q.width), Math.round(q.height), i.disabled]; }); return { alignItems: getComputedStyle(b).alignItems, panel: [Math.round(r.left), Math.round(r.right), Math.round(r.bottom)], items }; })()

steps.name: as expected
steps.assert: __vars.menu.alignItems === 'flex-end' && __vars.menu.panel[0] === 0 && __vars.menu.panel[1] === 390 && Math.abs(__vars.menu.panel[2] - 844) <= 1 && JSON.stringify(__vars.menu.items.map(i => i[0])) === JSON.stringify(['Play from here', 'Rename', 'Make a clip', 'Edit', 'Delete']) && __vars.menu.items.every(i => i[1] >= 200 && i[2] >= 40 && !i[3])

steps.name: the menu closed, the rename field in the row with Save and Cancel of at least 40 px
steps.waitFor: (() => { if (document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop')) return false; const row = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"] .jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.seed.a + '"]'); const f = row && row.querySelector('.jfbm-rename'); if (!f) return false; return { value: f.querySelector('input').value, buttons: [...f.querySelectorAll('button')].map(b => { const q = b.getBoundingClientRect(); return [b.title, Math.round(q.width), Math.round(q.height)]; }), inside: f.getBoundingClientRect().right <= 390 }; })()

steps.name: the title back
steps.waitFor: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"] .jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.seed.a + '"]'); return !!row && !row.querySelector('.jfbm-rename') && row.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title').textContent === 'page-probe phone range'; })()

steps.name: tick both rows
steps.script: const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"]'); for (const id of [__vars.seed.a, __vars.seed.b]) r.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + id + '"] .jfbm-row-select-box').click(); const bar = r.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-bar'); const b = bar.getBoundingClientRect(); return { count: bar.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-count').textContent, inside: b.left >= 0 && b.right <= 390 && b.bottom <= 844, buttons: [...bar.querySelectorAll('button')].map(x => Math.round(x.getBoundingClientRect().height)) };

steps.name: the bar fits, its buttons are at least 40 px tall
the bulk delete dialog as a bottom sheet
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop'); const p = b && b.querySelector('.jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Delete 2 bookmarks?') return false; const r = p.getBoundingClientRect(); return { alignItems: getComputedStyle(b).alignItems, panel: [Math.round(r.left), Math.round(r.right), Math.round(r.bottom)] }; })()

steps.name: the Player options dialog as a bottom sheet, its fields inside the screen
steps.waitFor: (() => { const b = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop'); const p = b && b.querySelector('.jfbm-panel'); if (!p || p.querySelector('h3').textContent !== 'Player options' || !p.querySelector('.jfbm-options-ask')) return false; const r = p.getBoundingClientRect(); const s = p.querySelector('.jfbm-options-shortcut').getBoundingClientRect(); return { alignItems: getComputedStyle(b).alignItems, panel: [Math.round(r.left), Math.round(r.right), Math.round(r.bottom)], field: [Math.round(s.left), Math.round(s.right), Math.round(s.height)] }; })()

steps.name: the page in Light: the theme sheet loaded, the accent resolved, the rows there
steps.waitFor: (() => { if (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') !== 'light' || !document.querySelector('link[href*="themes/light/theme.css"]')) return false; const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-state="on"]'); if (!r) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || ![__vars.seed.a, __vars.seed.b].every(id => !!c.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + id + '"]'))) return false; const accent = getComputedStyle(r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-segment[aria-pressed="true"]')).backgroundColor; return { accent, text: getComputedStyle(r.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title')).color }; })()

steps.name: the pressed segment carries the theme's accent (Light: #00a4dc), the text the page's
choose Apple TV for this browser
the page in Apple TV: the theme sheet loaded, the accent resolved, the rows there, the bulk bar's primary button in the accent too
steps.waitFor: (() => { if (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') !== 'appletv' || !document.querySelector('link[href*="themes/appletv/theme.css"]')) return false; const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-state="on"]'); if (!r) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || ![__vars.seed.a, __vars.seed.b].every(id => !!c.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + id + '"]'))) return false; r.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.seed.a + '"] .jfbm-row-select-box').click(); return { accent: getComputedStyle(r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-segment[aria-pressed="true"]')).backgroundColor, deleteButton: getComputedStyle(r.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-delete')).backgroundColor, text: getComputedStyle(r.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title')).color, html: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).color }; })()

steps.name: the pressed segment and Delete… carry the theme's accent (Apple TV: #00a4dc), the text the page's

the page in Purple Haze: the theme sheet loaded, the accent resolved, the rows there
steps.waitFor: (() => { if (document.documentElement.getAttribute('data-theme') !== 'purplehaze' || !document.querySelector('link[href*="themes/purplehaze/theme.css"]')) return false; const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-state="on"]'); if (!r) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || ![__vars.seed.a, __vars.seed.b].every(id => !!c.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + id + '"]'))) return false; r.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.seed.a + '"] .jfbm-row-select-box').click(); return { accent: getComputedStyle(r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-segment[aria-pressed="true"]')).backgroundColor, deleteButton: getComputedStyle(r.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-delete')).backgroundColor, text: getComputedStyle(r.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title')).color, html: getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).color }; })()

clean-up: the 'page-probe phone' bookmarks deleted
steps.script: const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: 'page-probe phone', limit: 200 })); const ids = r.Items.map(b => b.Id); const x = ids.length ? await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/BulkDelete'), data: JSON.stringify({ Ids: ids, DeleteClips: true }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }) : { Deleted: [] }; return { ids: ids.length, deleted: x.Deleted.length };
